job.titel: AI & Analytics Advisory Senior Manager – Agentic AI (all genders)
job.beschreibung:
Shape the next generation of intelligent enterprises by helping organizations move from traditional analytics to autonomous, AI‑driven decision-making. At Accenture Song, you combine strategy, data, and AI to turn bold visions into measurable impact.
Your Mission
You advise leading organizations on how to design and scale AI- and data-driven transformations with a strong focus on agentic AI and decision intelligence. From vision and strategy to execution, you help clients operationalize AI responsibly and at scale — turning insights into adaptive, automated business outcomes.
At Accenture, you shape the environment in which you thrive – with ways of working that suit you. You stay flexible and become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together.
Your Daily Work
Translate complex business challenges into AI, analytics, and agentic use cases linked to strategic objectives and measurable KPIs
Design data, AI, and agentic strategies, including first‑party data enablement, real-time activation, and decision intelligence frameworks
Define agentic AI architectures across data platforms, model layers, decisioning engines, and orchestration components
Advise clients on modern data ecosystems (e.g. lakehouses, data hubs, identity layers) enabling autonomous decision-making
Support the setup of AI operating models and Centers of Excellence, including governance for models, agents, and human‑in‑the‑loop systems
Lead executive workshops to shape AI visions, prioritize high‑impact use cases, and define transformation roadmaps
Build business cases quantifying AI impact across customer engagement, operations, and intelligent automation
Collaborate closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and architects to align strategy, models, and production deployment (MLOps / LLMOps)
Mentor junior colleagues and contribute to thought leadership in agentic AI and decision intelligence
Who You Are
You bring 5–8 years of experience in AI strategy, data analytics, or digital transformation consulting
You have a strong understanding of modern data platforms such as Azure, GCP, Databricks, BigQuery, or Snowflake
You are familiar with AI technologies and paradigms, including machine learning, LLMs, prompt engineering, and emerging agentic frameworks
You have experience with AI operationalization, including MLOps, LLMOps, governance, and monitoring
You are skilled at translating between business needs, data strategy, and technical AI implementation
You manage stakeholders confidently across business, data, IT, and AI leadership
You enjoy working in agile, cross‑functional environments
You communicate complex topics clearly and convincingly at executive level
What We Offer
The opportunity to shape cutting‑edge AI and agentic transformations for leading organizations
A highly collaborative, interdisciplinary environment at the intersection of strategy, creativity, data, and technology
Access to global thought leadership, advanced learning platforms, and continuous development opportunities
Flexible working models that support your individual lifestyle and career goals
A strong team culture built on trust, diversity, and shared success
Life at Accenture Song
Accenture Song is where creativity, technology, and data come together to create meaningful experiences and real business value. We work with our clients to design, build, and run solutions that drive growth and relevance in a rapidly changing world.
The Accenture Culture: Here, YOU are the catalyst for change
At Accenture, we believe that innovation starts with people. You’ll work in diverse teams, bring your authentic self to work, and grow in an environment that values individuality, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Contact Us
Any questions left? Feel free to contact our recruiting team via email at recruiting_germany@accenture.com.
We look forward to your application.
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
